import subprocess

# Test current remap behavior with cyclic structures
result = subprocess.run(
    ['python', '-c '''
from boltons.iterutils import remap

# Self-referential list
a = [1]
a.append(a)
try:
    result = remap(a)
    print("remap(cyclic):", result)
except RecursionError as e:
    print("remap(cyclic): RecursionError")

# Duplicate reference
inner = {"x": 1}
out = remap([inner, inner])
print("remap(duplicate):", out)
print("out[0] is out[1]:", out[0] is out[1])
'''],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print(result.stdout)
if result.stderr:
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr[-500:])
